loreRules: The last duty is one night; story time is not a real-time countdown.
Records are salt plates, handwritten duty logs and tide ledgers; pipes carry brine pressure/salinity signals.
Optics reveal existing curves and imprints, never past video, voices, intentions or ghosts.
Preserve a verification copy at first reading; retry on copies without destroying required clues.
A conclusion needs two independent source media; two copies are one origin.
Reversible trial is distinct from commitment; submission requires verifier confirmation and protagonist signature.
